source.citation: Larson et al., An Evaluation Dataset for Intent Classification and Out-of-Scope Prediction, EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019, https://aclanthology.org/D19-1131/
source.selection: All official test rows of selected domains and mapped intents. No CLINC train/val/oos splits used. Selection and mapping fixed before inference. Exclude normalized or punctuation-insensitive overlap with any BANKING77 train/test row, and within external selection.
source.feedback: Saved banking77-v1 evaluation dataset.feedback is null; no feedback used in artifact.
source.family_definition: NFKC lowercase project clean_text, then alphanumeric tokens joined; exact family hash only, no claim of semantic deduplication.

limits: Wilson intervals are row-binomial descriptive intervals; paraphrase families may remain dependent. Shift mapping covers only three intents, not all 77. OOD measures rejection, not 150-class accuracy.
